title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
@cursor Part 4 of 5 for issue #3: Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #3, then do ONLY Part 4.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): mask and block sensitive content, record form state (#3)` with tests and stubs, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Add `packages/recorder/src/privacy.ts` with the masking and blocking rules from Steps 3 of the issue, and record form state from Steps 4. Wire them into `serializeNode` in `packages/recorder/src/snapshot/` (Parts 2 and 3). Rules: `input[type=password]` value is never recorded. Elements with `data-rewind-mask` or class `rewind-mask`: text replaced by `*` of the same length. Elements with `data-rewind-block`: replaced by an empty placeholder with the same width and height. Options: `maskAllInputs` (default `true`), `maskTextSelector`, `blockSelector`. Record the current `value` of inputs, textareas and selects, and `checked` of checkboxes and radios, masked by the rules above.

Requirements:
- Password value never appears anywhere in output
- Masked text keeps its length
- Blocked element keeps width and height

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Tests: password, masked text, blocked element, checkbox, select, maskAllInputs on and off
- `grep` of the serialized password fixture
